name: Whisper Security
name_long: Whisper Security (viaGraph B.V.) - verifiable agent identity on AS219419
notes:
AS219419 announces 2a04:2a01::/32 (WHISPER-AGENTS) and 2a04:2a00::/32 (WHISPER-INFRA).

The agent block is unusual and worth explaining: every address in it is a per-/128 assignment to a single AI agent or workload, each with its own reverse DNS, its own DANE-EE TLSA pin published in DNSSEC-signed DNS, and its own RDAP record. Anyone can verify any of it with stock tools and no account:

  dig +short -x <address>
  delv @1.1.1.1 -x <address>          re-derives the DNSSEC chain locally
  curl -s https://rdap.whisper.online/ip/<address>

Peering: open policy, IPv6-only, transit-only today. We drop RPKI-invalids. Max-prefix 2.
Looking glass (RFC 8522, machine-readable JSON): https://whisper.online/.well-known/looking-glass/v1
Peering peering@whisper.security  NOC noc@whisper.security  Abuse/security security@whisper.security
